comment: Curated cross-entity folds for scripts/build_series_catalog.py. Each fold reads every current observation of the concept and geography that carries absorbed_entity as carrying survivor_entity when the catalog groups identities; the observation file is never changed. Undo a fold by removing it from this list, never by deleting the file. The seven folds below are the entity-drift families in docs/catalog-curation-backlog.md, folded into their economy/aggregate lineages by Max's ruling d353 (2026-09-27).
